target_customer: Finance teams of business groups with multiple subsidiaries, banks, asset managers and private equity portfolios, mainly in Spain
problem: Groups with many entities and bank accounts manage treasury, payables and invoicing manually. Snab centralizes banking and automates finance operations.
business_model: B2B SaaS modules (accounts payable, receivables and e-invoicing, treasury, AI financial analyst)

founders.name: Gorka Aguirre
prior_employers: Private equity firm in New York (6 years, over $2B AUM)
education: Degrees in law and business administration and a master's in finance (institutions not named)

founders.name: Juan Coll Soler
founders.background_notes: Listed as founder on YC page; a law firm note also names him.

technical_complexity.rationale: Bank connectivity, payment workflows and document extraction across entities is standard fintech engineering with integration work.

defensibility.rationale: Treasury and payables systems integrate deeply with banks and ERPs, which raises switching costs, but rival treasury tools exist.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Madrid treasury peer Embat raised a EUR 14.7M Series A and acquired Necto in 2025 per Finextra and PYMNTS. No acquisition of Snab found.

market_need_then: Founder Aguirre said in tech.eu coverage that he saw first hand the finance and treasury difficulties of businesses during his New York career. Spend data was not captured.

branding.domain_note: Uses snabfinance.com rather than snab.com, per the YC listing.

identity.visual_style: Plain B2B site with modules and bank customers
identity.voice_and_tone: Partner positioning, long term finance and technology partner powered by AI

brand_strength.rationale: Short name, but no brand press found. The site shows placeholder zero statistics.

outcome_analysis: Snab joined YC in Winter 2022 and closed a EUR 1.1M pre-seed in February 2023 from 4Founders Capital, Glenfarne Group, Y Combinator and angels. Its site now lists bank and asset manager customers such as Banca March and Kutxabank. No later round, exit or shutdown was found, so it looks like a small steady company.
